en.text: This Baptist place of worship is characterized by its community-focused ministries and regular Sunday congregations in the area.

en.name: Ang Dating Daan (MCGI)
en.text: Serving the Members Church of God International, this local chapter house is a hub for religious broadcasts and community prayer.

en.name: Ang Dating Daan (MCGI) Lokal ng Dila
en.text: This specific local branch in Dila provides a dedicated worship space and broadcast viewing area for members of the MCGI congregation.

en.name: Lifegiver Santa Rosa
en.text: Operating as an evangelical Christian center in Santa Rosa, this church organizes energetic worship services and youth outreach programs.

en.name: Saint Clare's Convent
en.text: This peaceful convent building serves as a cloistered residence for nuns and offers a serene chapel for contemplative prayer.

en.name: ADD Cabuyao Coordinating Center
en.text: Located in the municipality of Cabuyao, this local center coordinates religious activities and regular gatherings for the Ang Dating Daan followers.

en.name: Word for the World Cabuyao
en.text: This Cabuyao-based Christian fellowship focuses on contemporary worship music and teachings spreading the Gospel to the local community.

en.name: Lokal ng Elises
en.text: A dedicated local congregation hall serving the spiritual needs and regular weekly services of the surrounding Elises neighborhood.

en.name: Church of Christ at GMA
en.text: Situated in the GMA area, this Church of Christ building provides a formal setting for a capella singing and scriptural sermons.

en.name: Malia Seventh-day Adventist Church
en.text: This branch of the Adventist church in the Malia area observes Saturday worship and organizes active community health initiatives.

en.name: ADD Chrysanthemum
en.text: Located within the Chrysanthemum Village, this coordination center is a dedicated meeting spot for the local Ang Dating Daan members.

en.name: Filinvest SDA Church
en.text: Set within the Filinvest residential area, this church caters to Seventh-day Adventist families with Sabbath school programs and weekly sermons.

en.name: The Holy Family Chapel
en.text: Dedicated to the Holy Family, this intimate Catholic chapel provides a sacred space for neighborhood masses and private devotion.

en.name: Iglesia Ni Cristo
en.text: Known for its distinctive neo-Gothic spires, this Iglesia Ni Cristo chapel is a prominent architectural and religious landmark in the local area.

en.name: Langgam Church
en.text: Situated in the barangay of Langgam, this local church acts as the primary spiritual sanctuary for the surrounding village residents.

en.name: San Lorenzo Ruiz Parish Church
en.text: Dedicated to the first Filipino saint, this Catholic parish church features a spacious nave designed to accommodate large Sunday congregations.

en.name: Carpenter's House Baptist Church
en.text: Taking its name from the biblical trade of Jesus, this Baptist church offers Bible study sessions and community support programs.

en.name: Talipapa
en.text: This small, traditional "talipapa" wet market is filled with local vendors selling freshly caught fish, meat, and locally grown vegetables.

en.name: Big J Mini Market
en.text: A compact neighborhood marketplace where residents can conveniently purchase daily groceries, fresh produce, and basic household items.

en.name: San Jose Public Market
en.text: This bustling public market in the San Jose area is a daily destination for locals seeking fresh meats, spices, and everyday dry goods.

en.name: Sanjos Market
en.text: Serving as a lively community trading post, this market area is packed with independent retailers selling a mix of food supplies and clothes.

en.name: Santa Rosa Wet & Dry Market
en.text: This expansive municipal market is divided into wet sections for fresh seafood and meats, and dry sections for rice, grains, and textiles.

en.name: Biñan Public Market
en.text: Known as a major commercial center in the city, this bustling public market is famous for selling local sweet treats like Puto Biñan.

en.name: Tubigan
en.text: Located in the Tubigan barangay, this local marketplace provides residents with daily access to fresh agricultural produce and household essentials.
